objective: Determine whether Sentaurus CurrentWeighting changes the M50 gap between substrate electron field-derived contact-face flux and the reported substrate eCurrent while preserving the solved six-state device fields.

manual_basis.default_contact_current: sum of current-density integral over the surface of the doping well associated with the contact and charge-generation integral over that doping-well volume
manual_basis.CurrentWeighting: domain-integration method using a solution-dependent weighting function to minimize numeric errors
manual_basis.DirectCurrent: surface integral over the contact area
manual_basis.scope_guard: DirectCurrent is documented for interpretation but is not executed in M51

scope.intervention: add the CurrentWeighting flag to the otherwise byte-equivalent M50 global Math section

diagnostic_replay.input_tdrs: exact M50 input_fps.tdr copies inherited from frozen M8 process outputs
diagnostic_replay.deck_rule: M50 deck with diagnostic output names changed from M50 to M51 and the single CurrentWeighting flag added to Math; no other semantic change
diagnostic_replay.native_face_observable: CurrentPlot Tcl Integrate Contact=substrate IntegrationUnit=cm of eCurrentDensity dot ContactSurfaceNormal

state_invariance.baseline_snapshots: six frozen M50 m50_state TDR files
state_invariance.weighted_snapshots: six new M51 m51_state TDR files
state_invariance.rule: each compared value passes when either its absolute or symmetric relative difference is within threshold

analysis.terminal_comparison: compare CurrentWeighting-on source, drain, gate, and substrate electron, hole, and total currents with frozen M50 default values
analysis.native_flux_comparison: compare CurrentWeighting-on substrate electron contact-domain flux in both normal orientations with frozen M50 native flux

classifications.weighted_matches_native_face: state invariant and weighted substrate eCurrent closes to either fixed native-face orientation at all six states
classifications.weighted_matches_default: state invariant and weighted substrate eCurrent closes to frozen M50 default eCurrent at all six states but not native face
classifications.weighted_third_observable: state invariant but weighted substrate eCurrent closes to neither frozen default nor either native-face orientation
classifications.state_perturbed: any required solved field exceeds the frozen state-invariance threshold
classifications.replay_incomplete: required states or observables are missing

analysis.target_localization: report weighted-minus-default and weighted-minus-nearest-native residuals at the target, adjacent n23 gates, and matched n19 gate
analysis.claim_guard: M51 attributes a Sentaurus observation algorithm only; it does not authorize changing Vela or Sentaurus production defaults

forbidden_work: BGN, SRH, mobility, contact model, mesh, or production-default changes
adding HeteroInterface, Thermionic, or Discontinuity physics
rewriting M8 or M45 through M50 artifacts
deliverables: regression test for contract and evidence invariants
